title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - TestSuiteResult
description: A managed test case result resource (TM Forum TMF707 Test Result 4.0.0, Swagger definition TestSuiteResult; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:TestSuiteResult:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TestSuiteResult'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF707_TestResult/blob/v4.0.0/TMF707-TestResult-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteResult/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:TestSuiteResult:<tmfId>. unique identifier

testExecution.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF707_TestResult/blob/v4.0.0/TMF707-TestResult-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteResult/properties/testExecution'. In TMF this is a TestSuiteExecutionRefOrValue object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced TestSuiteExecution entity (urn:ngsi-ld:TestSuiteExecution:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF707_TestResult/blob/v4.0.0/TMF707-TestResult-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteResult/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF707_TestResult/blob/v4.0.0/TMF707-TestResult-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteResult/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF707_TestResult/blob/v4.0.0/TMF707-TestResult-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/TestSuiteResult/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'TestSuiteResult' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name
